info.title: Gremion governance — meeting, agenda, invitation and motion surface
info.description: OpenAPI 3.1 document for GOV's public HTTP surface (TASK-083, DOMAIN DB-GOV; PRD-MTG-001/002a/002b/003; TRD-408, TRD-005). Six resource families under /api/v1: meetings, agenda-sections, agenda-items, invitations (with notice-override and recipients), and motions (with motion-admissions). Routed to the governance service at the edge; the tenant comes from the host and token, never from the path (TRD-409). P3-additive resources (protocol, resolution, register, poll) are out of scope here. Error envelope: application/problem+json (RFC 9457), a named type URI per refusal. Pagination: a cursor (?cursor=&limit=) on list endpoints. Contract-first: edit this spec in the same change as the route. Coverage and breaking-change gates: see contracts/README.md and contracts/governance/README.md.

wahlperiode_id.description: Opaque IDT Wahlperiode reference (TRD-086). A mismatch with the body's current Wahlperiode warns and never blocks [D R17-14].

title.description: DB-GOV-MEETING.title. Served here (gov.meeting-read v1) and deliberately never carried in event payloads (DOMAIN GOV events table).

call_link_id.description: Display-only projection of msg.calllink.set.v1. MSG owns the meeting-to-call association; GOV never writes it except from MSG's event.

state.description: DOMAIN Meeting lifecycle. Moves only by that lifecycle (DB-GOV-MEETING invariant).

notice_period_days_snapshot.description: Ladungsfrist in days, snapshotted from the body's governance settings when the meeting was planned; later settings changes never alter it (DB-GOV-MEETING invariant).

motion_deadline_at.description: Snapshotted from the body's motion deadline offset when the meeting was planned.

cancel_reason.description: Set when state is cancelled: the chair cancelled, or the body was archived (DOMAIN Meeting lifecycle) [A: value names chosen here].

MeetingPage.description: One page of Meeting, in the list's stable server order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

wahlperiode_id.description: Opaque IDT Wahlperiode reference. Optional: when omitted the server records the body's current Wahlperiode [A]. A mismatch warns and never blocks [D R17-14].

MeetingUpdate.description: Retitle, relocate or reschedule. body_id is immutable and not accepted here (DOMAIN DB-GOV-MEETING invariant). A change of start or end emits de.gremion.gov.meeting.rescheduled.v1.

section_id.description: DB-GOV-AGENDA-SECTION id (bigint, carried as a string to avoid JS precision loss)

AgendaSectionPage.description: One page of AgendaSection, in the list's stable server order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

AgendaItemPage.description: One page of AgendaItem, in the list's stable server order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

agenda_snapshot_id.description: Frozen agenda snapshot (bigint, carried as a string to avoid JS precision loss)

state.description: DOMAIN Invitation lifecycle (PRD-MTG-002a/002b, FLOW-MTG-002). blocked = notice not met and no override yet; override_logged = the one notice-override is recorded; dispatch_refused = MAIL reports no connector for the body; partly_failed = some recipients failed or bounced. A blocked invitation never blocks the Sitzung [D R20-D26-5].

notice_met.description: False when sent_at would be after notice_due_at; a flag, never a block (PRD-MTG-002b).

InvitationPage.description: One page of Invitation, in the list's stable server order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

note.description: No required fields: an invitation draft is created from the meeting's current agenda snapshot server-side.

NoticeOverride.description: Append-only (PRD-MTG-002b / DOMAIN [D R20-D26-5]). No PUT/PATCH/DELETE exists for this resource — at most one per invitation, and it can never be undone or edited.

override_id.description: DB-GOV-NOTICE-OVERRIDE id (bigint, carried as a string to avoid JS precision loss)

InvitationRecipient.description: No address or email property is ever exposed — the evidence itself lives only in MAIL's DB-MAIL-DELIVERYEVIDENCE (DOMAIN DB-GOV-INVITATION-RECIPIENT invariant, D-nc memo D26).

recipient_id.description: DB-GOV-INVITATION-RECIPIENT id (UUIDv7; crosses to MAIL as recipient_reference)

InvitationRecipientPage.description: One page of InvitationRecipient, in the list's stable server order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

is_late.description: Computed on the server (submitted_at after deadline_snapshot). Never accepted from the client (PRD-MTG-003, FLOW-MTG-003 B1).

state.description: DOMAIN Motion lifecycle (PRD-MTG-003, FLOW-MTG-003). withheld = submitted after the deadline and marked late, off the agenda until an admission; pending_verification and expired belong to public intake, which stays off per body (DOMAIN GOV question 1).

MotionPage.description: One page of Motion, in the list's stable server order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

MotionAdmission.description: Append-only (DOMAIN DB-GOV-MOTION-ADMISSION). Only the chair decides (FLOW-MTG-003 C1).

admission_id.description: DB-GOV-MOTION-ADMISSION id (bigint, carried as a string to avoid JS precision loss)

motion_id.description: The late motion this admission decides

deferred_to_meeting_id.description: Required when outcome is defer (a target meeting, PRD-MTG-003).
